color_identity.future_expression_name_status: VM-367 controlled placeable expression key: colors [W,U,B,R,G], placement_eligible true, preview_eligible false, no public route expansion, and Five-Color public label.

placement_summary: Five-Color / WUBRG is a controlled placeable raw placement packet for users whose answers consistently value all five colors being present, negotiated, and source-bound rather than merely wanting broad goodstuff, mana fixing, or the strongest available deck.

moral_and_psychological_profile.primary_drive: Integrate every available color because the problem feels too alive, social, tactical, emotional, and material for one color or one missing-color frame.
moral_and_psychological_profile.ethical_pressure: Full access becomes misleading when every tool is included without tradeoffs, evidence, or a reason for each color to matter.
moral_and_psychological_profile.core_boundary: Placement language is Vox Mana synthesis, not official personality canon, deck-buying advice, or broad Commander recommendation authority.

placement_axes.label: Full-Spectrum Integration
placement_axes.description: Measures whether the user wants all five colors actively present and negotiated rather than one color, a guild, a shard, a wedge, a four-color missing-color frame, or Colorless restriction.
placement_axes.rationale: Layer 2 evidence supports WUBRG as full color access and Vox Mana synthesis, not official faction doctrine.

placement_axes.label: Breadth vs Dilution
placement_axes.description: Separates principled five-color breadth from generic goodstuff, accumulation, or support-link padding.
placement_axes.rationale: The WUBRG packet requires no field-count padding and treats weak deck/search claims as support-only.

placement_axes.label: Deck Access vs Card Bounds
placement_axes.description: Tests whether the user understands that full Commander color access does not erase individual card, color-pie, or legality boundaries.
placement_axes.rationale: Official Commander and color-pie sources support deck-level access with individual-card boundaries.

placement_axes.label: Coalition vs Superiority
placement_axes.description: Separates Five-Color coalition and synthesis from claims that WUBRG is above, beyond, or better than other identities.
placement_axes.rationale: WUBRG evidence supports synthesis language but bars superiority and official-doctrine claims.
placement_axes.notes: Use as false-positive check against totalizing language.

discriminator_questions.question: Does the answer need all five colors present, or is one color, pair, shard, wedge, four-color, or Colorless lane doing the real work?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates WUBRG fullness from partial color frames and Colorless restriction.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports WUBRG when the user explicitly wants all five colors active and meaningful in one plan.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens WUBRG when the answer only needs one color cluster, a missing-color frame, or outside-WUBRG restriction.

discriminator_questions.question: Is the breadth purposeful, or is the answer just collecting every strong card and calling the pile an identity?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates full-spectrum synthesis from generic goodstuff.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports WUBRG when the user can explain why each color belongs and what tradeoff full access creates.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens WUBRG when power, access, or card quality replaces identity reason.

discriminator_questions.question: Does full deck access stay bounded by card color identity, color-pie limits, and current legality checks?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Protects WUBRG from turning deck-level access into unbounded card or legality claims.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports WUBRG when the user treats all-five access as Commander deck construction while preserving individual card boundaries.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens WUBRG when the user assumes every card, legality claim, or mechanical claim is automatically available because the deck is five-color.

discriminator_questions.question: Is WUBRG being framed as coalition and synthesis, or as the best, highest, or final form of the color pie?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Separates healthy Five-Color synthesis from superiority and total-mastery language.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports WUBRG when the user wants all five colors held in tension without making them superior to other identities.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens WUBRG when it becomes a claim of superiority, official doctrine, or total mastery.

discriminator_questions.question: Are Commander decks and search links being used as support navigation, or as proof of lore, legality, popularity, or placement?
discriminator_questions.purpose: Keeps WUBRG support-only deck and search material in its proper role.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_supports_this_factio: Supports WUBRG when the user accepts deck/search rows as browsing support and asks for manual verification before exact claims.
discriminator_questions.answer_pattern_that_weakens_this_faction: Weakens WUBRG when support rows or external links are treated as source proof for lore, legality, rankings, price, or deck quality.

collision_guidance.rule: Treat WUBRG as all five colors present, not as Colorless, four-color, generic goodstuff, or official doctrine.

pairs.separator: WUBRG is all five colors present; Colorless is outside-WUBRG restriction.
pairs.ask: Does the user want every color available, or do they want the absence and constraint of color?
pairs.placement_confusion_reproduced: VM-369 reproduced WUBRG and COLORLESS as top two candidates after paired Hall answers, with a 0.0178 probability gap and needsCrucible=true before a pair-specific Crucible existed.

pairs.separator: Four-color identities are defined by a missing color; WUBRG has no missing color.
pairs.ask: Is the missing color meaningful, or does the user want the whole color wheel present?

pairs.separator: Goodstuff or single-color taste is not Five-Color synthesis.
pairs.ask: Can the user explain what each color contributes?

calibration_tuning.false_positive_guardrail: Do not place WUBRG when the answer only wants power, fixing, generic access, Colorless restriction, or a missing-color frame; require all-five integration and source-bound tradeoff awareness.

semantic_guidance_evidence.bounded_paraphrase: Generic goodstuff and broad mechanics access are false positives unless all five colors have purposeful roles, bounded evidence, and explicit tradeoffs.
Mana fixing or access alone does not establish WUBRG identity; Commander deck access must remain distinct from identity meaning and verified mechanics claims.
Five-Color coalition and synthesis do not authorize superiority, total mastery, universal-superset, endpoint, or final-form claims.
WUBRG is a technical structural code and Vox Mana synthesis, not an official faction, doctrine, plane, civilization, guild, college, or personality.
All five colors present and negotiated is the WUBRG side of the boundary; outside-WUBRG restriction and strict Colorless identity remain distinct.
Four-color identities are missing-color frames and partial-color identities remain narrower centers; neither becomes WUBRG without every color meaningfully present.
Commander products, decks, and support rows may provide navigation or examples but cannot prove lore, legality, placement, popularity, ranking, metagame position, or deck quality.
Broad search results and named-card leads remain discovery/support until exact card text, legality, and claim scope are manually verified.

use_when: Use WUBRG when the user clearly wants all five colors present and meaningful.
Use Five-Color as public-facing language, with WUBRG as technical shorthand.
Use Commander, deck, MTGDecks, Archidekt, and Scryfall material only as bounded support navigation.
avoid_when: The answer only names good cards, fixing, or broad access.
The answer treats WUBRG as official faction lore or superiority.
The answer is really Colorless, four-color, or a single color cluster.
The answer needs exact legality, card text, rankings, price, or metagame advice without current verification.
